generate:
# A TABLE-FOOTBALL TABLE SEEN FROM ABOVE. Five rods across the table -- the "=" handles poke
# out through the side walls -- each rod a row of men (letters, one team per rod) evenly
# spaced along it; the ball "o" lies in one of the gaps between the rods; the goal mouths are
# the holes in the two end walls. A rod shuffles sideways until one of its men stands in the
# ball's column: the short way if it fits, otherwise the long way round, and not at all if
# both ways would push a man off the table. A rod with a man already in the ball's column
# stays where it is. The caption counts the rods that move. ~12 % of clues say "0 shuffle".
FB = (" +----------      ----------+ \n"
      "=|A-----A-----A-----A-----A-|=\n"
      " |                          | \n"
      "=|--B------B------B------B--|=\n"
      " |                          | \n"
      "=|-----A-------A-------A----|=\n"
      " |      o                   | \n"
      "=|-B--------B--------B------|=\n"
      " |                          | \n"
      "=|-A-------A-------A-------A|=\n"
      " +----------      ----------+ \n"
      "2 shuffle")


def generate(seed):
    r = random.Random(seed)
    z = r.random() < 0.12                          # 12 % of tables have nothing to shuffle
    w = 0 if z else r.choice((1, 2, 2, 3, 3))      # how many rods shuffle
    u = "SX"[r.randrange(2)]                       # a single mover: short way or long way
    for att in range(600):
        W = r.randint(30, 36)                      # full line width, handles included
        I = W - 4                                  # playing width between the side walls
        R = []
        for i in range(5):
            g = r.randint(6, 9)                    # spacing of the men along this rod
            k = (I - 1) // g + 1                   # men on the rod: the rod is nearly full
            if not z and r.random() < 0.3:
                k -= 1                             # a rod with room to spare
            if k < 3:
                break
            sp = (k - 1) * g
            R.append((r.randrange(I - sp) + 2, g, k, sp))
        if len(R) < 5:
            continue
        cols = []
        for b in range(2, W - 2):
            T = []
            for (o, g, k, sp) in R:
                q = (b - o) % g                    # shift to the right that reaches the ball
                if q + q == g:
                    T = None
                    break                          # a dead heat: never shipped
                lg = o - 2                         # spare room at the left-hand end
                rg = W - 3 - o - sp                # spare room at the right-hand end
                fr = q <= rg                       # the right-hand man stays on the table
                fl = g - q <= lg                   # the left-hand man stays on the table
                if not q:
                    T.append(("H", 0))             # a man is already in the ball's column
                    continue
                if q + q < g:
                    u1, u2 = ("S", q), ("X", q - g)
                else:
                    u1, u2 = ("S", q - g), ("X", q)
                if (fr if u1[1] > 0 else fl):
                    v = u1
                elif (fr if u2[1] > 0 else fl):
                    v = u2
                else:
                    T.append(("N", lg > 0 < rg))   # jammed, though it could still edge over
                    continue
                d = v[1]
                # roles that refute the two readings a demo alone would suggest:
                # "it goes the way it has more room" and "it goes the ball's way"
                T.append((v[0], 4 * ((d > 0) != (rg >= lg) and fr and fl)
                          + 2 * ((d > 0) != (b > o + sp // 2))))
            if T is None:
                continue
            t = [u for u, _ in T]
            n = 5 - t.count("H") - t.count("N")
            if (n == 0) != z or n > 3:
                continue
            if "H" not in t or "N" not in t:
                continue                           # both near-misses are in every picture
            if not [1 for u, v in T if u == "N" and v]:
                continue                           # a jammed rod that could still edge closer
            if n:
                f = 0
                for u, v in T:
                    if u in "SX":
                        f |= v
                if f != 6:
                    continue                       # both refutations are in every picture
            if n > 1 and ("X" not in t or "S" not in t):
                continue                           # the long way round and the short way, both
            if n > 1 and len({"AB"[i % 2] for i, (u, _) in enumerate(T) if u in "SX"}) < 2:
                continue                           # the movers are never all from one team
            cols.append((b, n, "".join(t)))
        pick = [x for x in cols if x[1] == w and (w != 1 or u in x[2])]
        if not pick and att > 250:
            pick = cols                            # a stubborn seed: take any legal table
        if not pick:
            continue
        b, n, _ = r.choice(pick)
        a = (I - 6) // 2
        wall = " +" + "-" * a + " " * 6 + "-" * (I - 6 - a) + "+ "
        P = [wall]
        y = r.randrange(4)
        for i, (o, g, k, sp) in enumerate(R):
            row = ["-"] * I
            for j in range(k):
                row[o - 2 + j * g] = "AB"[i % 2]
            P.append("=|" + "".join(row) + "|=")
            if i < 4:
                e = [" "] * I
                if i == y:
                    e[b - 2] = "o"
                P.append(" |" + "".join(e) + "| ")
        P.append(wall)
        return "\n".join(P) + "\n" + str(n) + " shuffle"
    return FB
solve:
def solve(clue):
    L = clue.split("\n")
    T = L.pop()                                    # the "<n> shuffle" caption, copied through
    W = len(L[0])
    b = max(y.find("o") for y in L)                # the ball's column
    E = []
    for y in L:
        m = [i for i, x in enumerate(y) if "A" <= x <= "Z"]
        if m:
            o = m[0]
            g = m[1] - o
            q = (b - o) % g                        # the shift to the right that reaches the ball
            fr = q <= W - 3 - m[-1]                # nobody pushed off the right-hand side
            fl = g - q <= o - 2                    # nobody pushed off the left-hand side
            if not q:
                d = 0                              # a man is already in the ball's column
            elif q + q < g:
                d = q if fr else (q - g if fl else 0)
            else:
                d = q - g if fl else (q if fr else 0)
            x = ["-"] * (W - 4)
            for i in m:
                x[i - 2 + d] = y[i]
            y = "=|" + "".join(x) + "|="
        E.append(y.rstrip())
    return "\n".join(E) + "\n" + T
